name: redeemid/collection
title: Shopify Collection
description: A grid of a Shopify collection's products with live prices, rendered on the server. Single-option products get an Add to cart (or buy-now) button; Next and Previous are plain links, so it works without JavaScript and without Shopify's own plugin.

attributes.label: Shopify collection
attributes.help: Search your Shopify collections by title. Leave empty on RedeemID's collection page template to show the collection in the URL.

attributes.label: Buy button label
attributes.help: Used while RedeemID's cart is off.

attributes.label: Add to cart label
attributes.help: Used when RedeemID's cart is on.
